source.title: Graphite under uniaxial compression along the c axis: A parameter to relate out-of-plane strain to in-plane phonon frequency
source.authors: Y. W. Sun, D. Holec, and D. J. Dunstan
source.license_or_terms: Publisher article is copyrighted. Public arXiv author version used as a locator; no article copy is redistributed.

method.electronic_structure: DFT, PBE, PAW carbon potentials, Grimme van der Waals correction, VASP
method.preprocessing: Manual transcription from published article text and model results; no curve digitization, refit, interpolation, or target-data selection.

e2g2_axial_gruneisen_prime.locator: arXiv v3, Eq. (7), Sec. III.3, Fig. 5(a), Sec. III.4

e2g2_axial_frequency_shift_per_percent_s.locator: arXiv v3, Sec. III.3, Fig. 5(a), compression up to about 10 GPa

e2g2_hydrostatic_frequency_shift.source_notation: linear least-square fit up to 10 GPa

e2g2_refined_hydrostatic_gruneisen.locator: arXiv v3, Sec. III.3-Sec. III.4; compared with experiments

source_relationship.relationship: Sun et al. cite Hanfland et al. as Ref. 19 and state that the selected hydrostatic-model gamma was validated by comparison with experiments.

uncertainty_policy.allowed_propagation: Propagate Hanfland parenthetic errors as endpoint rectangles while holding rounded DFT gamma_prime fixed; not a statistical confidence interval and omits model uncertainty.
